GEOGRAPHY

THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

Pilot project on electricity reforms in Bangladesh, India (West Bengal, Rajasthan) and Nepal

The question
behind the work.

Development of base papers for Bangladesh on electricity reforms, a training manual for territorial-level training programmes, and an advocacy document highlighting impediments.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Conducted economic and financial feasibility assessments of the impact of electricity reforms on market structures, pricing mechanisms and investment frameworks.

  2. 02

    Analyzed tariff structures, cost-recovery models and subsidy mechanisms against financial sustainability and consumer affordability.

  3. 03

    Developed financial models to assess public-private partnership potential, identifying investment opportunities and financial risks.

  4. 04

    Conducted comparative cost-benefit analysis of regulatory frameworks across Bangladesh, India and Nepal.
